note: Instruction changes to documents that are inlined into a runtime prompt. Each entry is an explicit, reviewed change. Anything not listed here is a defect: the parity tests and scripts/prompt_diff.py both fail on an unrecorded difference.

approved.reason: The style contract told the model that a profile lives in `src/editorial/prompts/style-profiles.mjs`, a path removed when JavaScript was retired. It now names the actual location, `prompts/profiles/<profile-id>.yaml`, and describes module files rather than heading extraction.

Phase 3A stops inlining the digest configuration as one document. Analyze now receives only its `## Selection` and `## Reader` sections as a delimited reading-instructions block. The contract's 'What you receive' list names the sections it actually gets instead of the whole file.

Phase 3A stops inlining the digest configuration. Frame now receives its `## Reader`, `## Content preferences` and `## Optional highlights` sections as a reading-instructions block, and its 'What you receive' list names them.

Phase 3A stops inlining the digest configuration. Draft now receives its `## Reader`, `## Content preferences` and `## Optional highlights` sections as a reading-instructions block, and its 'What you receive' list names them.

Phase 3A stops inlining the digest configuration, and render receives no reading instructions at all: rendering is a presentation layer. The contract now says so explicitly rather than promising a document the stage is not given.

Phase 3B deduplication. The concision invariant was stated verbatim in both `system/contracts/line-edit.md` and `system/naturalness-contract.md` — two owners for one rule. It now has one owner (`line-edit.md`), and the naturalness contract refers to it rather than repeating it. No requirement changed: the invariant is unchanged and still delivered to the same stage.

phase3a.note: Structural changes Phase 3A makes to prompt delivery, distinct from the wording changes above.

removed_documents.reason: The digest configuration file is no longer inlined whole. Its operational frontmatter stays operational, and its Markdown body is parsed into the four canonical reading-instruction sections. Each stage now receives only the sections routed to it, as a `reading_instructions` block. No preference was lost: the same text reaches the same stages that act on it.

augmented_contracts.reason: The reader contract handed to the developmental review is now the shared reader contract plus the digest's `## Reader` section, so the judge reasons from the same effective Reader Brief the writing stages used. The shared text is unchanged and still present verbatim.

The reader contract handed to the reader review is now the shared reader contract plus the digest's `## Reader` section, so the before/after assessment uses the same effective Reader Brief as drafting. The shared text is unchanged and still present verbatim.

phase3b.note: Phase 3B structural changes: instruction ownership and deduplication.

removed_documents.reason: The research basis is maintainer-facing provenance, not a runtime checklist. It states the expert sources behind the writing references and how their ideas are used; its operational guidance already lives in the writing references and, for the reasoning it carried into Analyze, in `system/writing-reasoning-and-source-fidelity.md`. `system/workflow.md` already declared it 'provenance for maintainers' that 'need not be loaded during normal digest execution', but the stage table inlined it into Analyze — the largest single document in that prompt (10,579 chars). It is retained in the repository as a reference and is no longer inlined into any stage.
